entry.title: Meetup on the 6th of December, 2016
entry.content:
Talk 1: Functional Programming Principles in PHP

Taking a look at common FP principles and if/how they can be applied to PHP.

by Kai Sassnowski

Talk 2: Solving the hardest problem in IT

Introduction to Lizards & Pumpkins and techniques we are using and why.

by Fabian Blechschmidt

Talk 3: Vorstellung TURBOPY Framework

Einführung in Architektur und Konzepte des noSQL Publishing Frameworks

by Johannes Reichardt

entry.title: Meetup on the 3rd of December, 2013
entry.content:
Talk 1: Highly connected data with Neo4j

Introducing the Neo4j graph database and the available php libraries to use.

by Christophe Willemsen

Talk 2: Validating JSON with JSON Schema

Introduction to validation with JSON Schema and an implementation in PHP

by Anne-Julia Scheuermann

entry.title: Meetup on the 3rd July, 2012 // Treffen am 3. Juli, 2012
entry.content:
English

  • Daniel Fahlke: Webbased IRC (including POC code)
  • Jan Lehnardt:
    • Password Hashing Best Practices
    • Introduction to ext/couchbase - Slides
  • Nikolas Martens: Walk the line - A relentless approach to transparent persistence

We meet at co.up as always, drinks are available for a small fee. The meetup starts at 7pm, talks start at 7:30pm.

Looking forward to seeing all of you.

Deutsch

  • Daniel Fahlke: IRC für den Browser (Mit Beispiel-Code!)
  • Jan Lehnardt:
    • Passwörter richtig verschlüsseln
    • Einführung in ext/couchbase - Slides
  • Nikolas Martens: Walk the line - Ein kompromissloser Ansatz für transparente Persistenz

Wie immer treffen wir uns bei co.up, Getränke sind gegen ein kleines Entgelt zu haben. Wir treffen uns um 19:00 Uhr, die Vorträge beginnen gegen 19:30 Uhr.

Wir freuen uns auf euch.
